name: Shanghai Baolong Automotive Corporation
summary: Shanghai Baolong Automotive Corporation manufactures and sells automotive parts and components. It provides automotive rubber and metal parts, including traditional and tire pressure monitoring system valves; electronically controlled air suspension system; automotive metal tubing, such as exhaust pipes, EGR pipes, roof rail, and metal brackets; and automotive structural parts. It also provides tire pressure monitoring system; automotive sensors, that includes pressure rain and light, speed and position, current, and accelerator sensors; intelligent drive solutions; and automotive aftermarket and equipment products. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
